opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland and enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution, who are not eligible for government tuition fee support. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Funding to cover tuition fees for undergraduate students at Scottish higher education institutions from low-income households who are ineligible for government tuition fee support. Applications processed on a first-come-first-served basis.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh), ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, and without a prior postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for postgraduate study (SCQF Level 11) in plant science and botany, to widen participation and support Scotland's net-zero and biodiversity workforce.
